sections.html: The males have strongly enlarged fins and in both sexes an orange spot above the operculum can be present. The pattern of the operculum is rather reminiscent of the closely related species Crenicara latruncularium, but the fin formula is identical with C. punctulatum. This new population (or species) of Crenicara is in any case very attractive.
